changes: Added a shared runtimeMode contract in runtime-environment-checks, wired check/doctor JSON and plain text to it, added managed asset next-action guidance, and extended validation-protocol smoke coverage for runtimeMode enums, CLI first-screen UX, unsafe managed asset boundaries, and packaged-runtime conflict degradation.
usage: Use node packages/main/dist/cli.js check --json or doctor --format=json to read top-level runtimeMode; use plain check/doctor to see the Runtime footprint block before detailed diagnostics. Koala Mac B-3e9a must consume this through node bin/koala.js check/doctor wrapper commands.
expectedOutcome: Plain check and doctor first show Runtime footprint, Runtime mode, Project-local JavaScript runtime required, Authority, and Next action. JSON check and doctor expose the same top-level runtimeMode. Project-local JavaScript is required only for project-local-package.
actualTranscript: node packages/main/dist/cli.js check --json showed runtimeMode mode=compatibility-launcher source=repo-local-dist requiresProjectJavaScriptRuntime=false authority=local-runtime-diagnostic-only. node packages/main/dist/cli.js doctor --format=json showed matching top-level runtimeMode and runtime.runtimeMode. Plain check and doctor both started with Runtime footprint, Runtime mode: compatibility-launcher, Project-local JavaScript runtime required: no, Authority: local-runtime-diagnostic-only, and Next action. koala validate --story=B-39d9 --json passed with 12/12 verification intents covered.
outcomeDiff: Actual matches expected for core CLI. The only intended difference is scope: B-39d9 proves core dist CLI readiness, while Koala Mac wrapper proof is intentionally left to B-3e9a.
limitations: Core story only: Koala Mac wrapper commands are not claimed here and remain B-3e9a evidence. RuntimeMode is diagnostic-only and not production authority evidence.
pitfalls: Packaged runtime initially short-circuited local-bin conflict detection; reviewer caught it, and the fix now checks project-local bin conflicts before accepting packaged-runtime. Dist CLI evidence was also needed because bare koala resolves to the global/main install on this machine.
